counting_note: SEED COUNT and CONFIGURATION COUNT are separate numbers. 3 seeds x 3 arms = 9 arm-runs. That is 3 SEEDS, never '9 seeds'.

displacement.how_to_read: these are ||.||^2 RELATIVE, so the reference displacement rho = 0.10 corresponds to 0.01 here. REPORTED, never tuned against.

probe_absolute_NOT_A_CLAIM.note: an absolute probe number says how easy Shapes3D is under a linear readout; only the margin says anything about the arm

MARGIN.metric: distinct_valid_novel_tuples (PRIMARY), per corner, paired by corner
MARGIN.primary_degenerate_note: the primary metric separates the arms and is the one used
MARGIN.best_chosen_by: highest mean novel-per-corner among THIS ARM's own refit baselines -- chosen per arm, so the bar is always the strongest available competitor on that arm's features

paired_vs_best_learned.note: the unit is the CORNER, paired; the verdict is this estimand and never a single cell (w3-hub-common section 3: the corner explains 90.9% of the paired variance)

MARGIN.how_to_read: wave 12 measured this NEGATIVE. The bar is whether it GROWS from `frozen` to an adapted arm. A margin that grows and stays negative is a real and reportable result.

ledger_four_part.note: four parts summed, never netted; the 524,288 B column is a REFERENCE only this wave -- the single design is 1x its own total
